selected_evidence.summary: Effective Storage=persistent configuration, active files under /var/log/journal, and previous-boot logs remain readable.
Journald applies a 1 GiB cap and 14-day policy; logrotate validates daily rotation, 14 archives, and 100 MiB early rotation after reboot.
The pre-reboot marker remains readable from the previous journal boot and /var/log/messages; a post-reboot marker reaches both logging paths.

Healthy baseline captured; native reboot acknowledged; boot ID changed from 8ac0a119-4645-4ec4-a262-37892ad89da1 to da60b6d1-476e-4fdb-9a76-c5c1cd270f4f; journald, rsyslog, and crond recovered with intact journal data.
